The operator reviews the service before making a change. Requests are arriving steadily, the queue is draining, and the latest deployment has completed. A useful summary explains what changed, what was checked, and what still needs attention.

Start with a small reproducible workload. Record the source size and the number of updates, then compare the measured cost with the available time between updates. Larger responses should remain readable as new text arrives. Words such as café and 界 also exercise terminal cell measurements.

Repeated observations help separate a consistent cost from background activity. Keep the input fixed, preserve the output, and describe the machine used for the investigation. The result should let another developer repeat the experiment and understand its limits.
